description.value:
You detonate a burst of cryogenic energy in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within range. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d6 + 20 cold damage and becoming restrained for 1 minute, encased in carbonite, on a failure, or half as much damage and restrained only until the end of its next turn on a success.

As an action, a restrained creature may make a Strength check against your tech save DC, ending the restraint on itself on a success. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this power dies instantly as its carbonite shell shatters.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 9
